entry_group_id.description: The id of the entry group to create. The id must begin with a letter or underscore, contain only English letters, numbers and underscores, and be at most 64 characters.
entry_group_id.rationale: This is a user-defined identifier and does not control access to the resource or data.

display_name.description: A short name to identify the entry group, for example, "analytics data - jan 2011".
display_name.rationale: This is only a human-readable display name and does not control access to the resource or data.

description.description: Entry group description, which can consist of several sentences or paragraphs that describe entry group contents.
description.rationale: This is only descriptive metadata and does not control access to the resource or data.

region.rationale: Entry groups should be created only in approved regions to meet data residency and governance requirements.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project ID is an identifier for locating the resource and does not by itself enforce a security control.
